candidate_windows.window_text: We implemented FFLM with the foundation language model LLaMa (Touvron et al., 2023). It contains models with different sizes, where LLaMa7b is selected for our main experiments. We add "TL;DR" between the conditional sequence and the target sequence. The weights in Eq. 7 are determined in $\{0.0, 0.1, \dots, 1.0\}$ according to the performance on the corresponding validation set for inconsistency detection. For faithfulness rating, we set $\alpha, \beta, \delta$ as $0.25, 0.25, 0.5$ respectively, with the intuition that the former two are from the same category as introduced in Sec. 2.1. Our experiments are done on a single RTX 3090.
